messages:
sanjeev: Heads-up — postmortem published for the 2025-05-02 latency incidents: https://.../postmortem/INC-2025-05-latency. TL;DR: repeated 95th pct latency spikes during peak commit windows, error budget burned ~4% over 72h (target was <1%).

maria: Ack. can you propose concrete mitigation + owners? is this a one-off or recurring pattern?

sanjeev: Looking at traces it’s recurring on weekdays around deploy windows. Root cause: autoscaler mis-evaluating queued request signals when batch jobs kick off. Short-term proposal: temporarily relax 95p SLO from 120ms -> 150ms for a 2-week calibration window while we deploy the autoscaler fix and throttling. Long-term: autoscaler fix + batch-job isolation.

alex: prefer not to touch SLO if we can avoid it. alternative: apply conservative throttling to background batch traffic and add a per-tenant concurrency cap during peaks. Less customer-visible.

jess: I can take dashboard + alert work. Will add panels for: 95p by route, queue depth, batch-traffic contribution, and an error-budget burn rate heatmap. Also add alert: error_budget_remaining < 0.7% sustained 30m -> page.

taylor: I can own the SLO flag rollout if we go that route. Need a precise rollback plan (how to revert to 120ms, traffic gating). Also want canary window and synthetic checks.

maria: timeline requested: when do we need ownership committed by? ops oncall needs the exact alert thresholds to avoid noisy pages.

sanjeev: Proposed action plan (short):
- autoscaler hotfix (code + perf test) — owner: alex — due: 2025-05-06
- batch-job throttle + concurrency cap — owner: alex — due: 2025-05-04
- dashboard updates + alert tuning — owner: jess — due: 2025-05-03
- SLO temporary relaxation (if accepted) behind FF + rollback playbook — owner: taylor — schedule: 2025-05-02 22:00 UTC -> 2 weeks
- runbook update for Tue deploy window (investigation checklist + mitigation) — owner: maria — due: 2025-05-05

alex: I’ll split autoscaler hotfix into two PRs (safety checks then perf). tagging @sanjeev for code review.

monitoring-bot: metric snapshot: 95p_latency_us: baseline=110ms, incident_peak=240ms, median=45ms; error_budget_used=4.1% (72h).

ops-bot: created ticket MON-4822 for dashboard work, link: https://.../MON-4822

jess: MON-4822 created, I added the panel list and initial queries. Will push a draft dashboard and assign to @maria for threshold review.

maria: For alerts: please keep pager threshold conservative. Suggest page only at >1% burn sustained 30m, warn at 0.5% 30m. Ops oncall: confirm this won't double-page with existing infra alerts.

taylor: Rollout plan (if SLO relax chosen):
1) enable FF for 10% orgs 2025-05-02 22:00 UTC; watch synthetic checks 15m
2) increase to 50% after 2h if stable
3) full for public after 24h if no regression
Rollback: immediate FF off, revert flag and re-run synthetic tests.

sanjeev: OK. Decision path: try mitigations (throttle + autoscaler fix). If error budget still burns 24h after rollout, we enable temporary SLO relaxation behind FF. No SLO change unless we confirm customer-visible impact > threshold.

alex: noted. starting work on throttle PR now, will post PR link.

jess: Dashboard draft pushed, review link: https://.../dash/preview/4822 — tagging @maria and @taylor.

maria: reviewed dashboard, adjusted warn/page thresholds. Good to go.

sanjeev: Final action items copied to postmortem doc and action tracker. I'll run a daily 09:30 UTC check-in for 7 days to monitor error budget.

alex: PRs opened: https://.../pr/789 (throttle) and https://.../pr/790 (autoscaler safety).

jess: Closing loop: dashboards will be handed to monitoring-owners after 48h of stability.

taylor: I’ll prepare the FF and canary config today.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: daily check-in at 09:30 UTC (next 7 days).

sanjeev: Thanks everyone. keep comments to the postmortem doc for audit trail. :thumbsup:
